## Supplier quote extractor
Default: bid 4022, preview only.
Start Procura, select your saved Gemini credential, execute and inspect Validate extraction.
Unknown quote values stay null. Catalog prices never fill quote gaps.

After reviewing, set save_draft=true in Choose quote. Only extracted_bid_lines is written; original bid lines stay unchanged.
See docs/quote-extractor.md.
